instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a side-angle view with a shallow depth of field. The scene is set in a bright, minimalist indoor office with a white wall and a black monitor in the background. On the left foreground, the woman with highlighted brown hair in a light blue blazer (R1) stands in profile, smiling and clapping. Just behind her on the right, the woman with long dark hair in a purple tweed blazer (R2) stands facing right, laughing and clapping in unison. Soft, bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting a cool color palette of blues and purples.
